# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> A spacious four bedroom detached home featuring a dual aspect living room with bay window, a kitchen and dining area with bay window and double doors leading to the garden, a utility with external access, useful storage space and a WC. Upstairs, you will find a main bedroom with en suite, three further bedroom and a modern bathroom.
